source: people's verdicts from the online review queue (lecture 11.3): sampled production traces, relabelled as cases
on_refresh: add 4 to 8 new cases from the last month's review queue, keeping every category at 4 or more
retire cases older than three months into the golden set, where prompt authors may read them
re-record the deployed handler on the new cases, then write the baseline in its own reviewed change
rules: no prompt, worked example or fine-tuning record is written from these cases
no held-out case shares a flight with the golden set: the same flight and facts in a new format is the same case
per-case results never go to CI logs; the gate prints category numbers only
the contamination check runs against golden and every model input on every pull request
